tasks.instruction: Write an essay on the topic below. Cover all the notes and support your opinion with reasons.

choices.title: Essay
choices.input:
Your class has been talking about transportation in cities. Now your teacher has asked you to write an essay.

Some people say that cars should be banned from city centers. To what extent do you agree?

Notes. Write about:
1. air quality and noise
2. access for shoppers and workers
3. (your own idea)
choices.prompt: Write your essay in 140-190 words. Use all the notes and give reasons for your point of view.

points.label: Own idea, for example an alternative way to travel

tasks.instruction: Pick one of the three tasks below and write your text for it.

choices.title: Article
choices.input:
You see this announcement in an English-language magazine for young people.

Articles wanted: A place where I relax. Tell us about a place that helps you relax, what you do there and why it is important to you. The best articles will be published next month.

points.label: Says what the writer does there
Explains why the place is important
Encourages readers to find their own place

choices.title: Email
choices.input:
You have received an email from your English-speaking friend Sam, who is coming to stay with you for a weekend.

I can't wait to visit! What should I pack? What would you like us to do while I'm there? And is there anything I should know about your town before I arrive?
choices.prompt: Write your email to Sam in 140-190 words.

points.label: Gives useful information about the town

choices.title: Review
choices.input:
Your local library is collecting reviews on its website.

Tell us about a film, a book or a concert that you enjoyed recently. Say what it was about, what you liked and disliked about it, and whether you would recommend it to other people.
